# Synthetic phone fixtures

`phone.heic` is a 96×64 red/blue image created for Corto with Pillow and pillow-heif, with EXIF orientation 6. `phone-hdr.mp4` is a one-second FFmpeg test pattern encoded as 10-bit HEVC with BT.2020/PQ metadata. Both were created on 2026-11-16 and are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. No personal phone recording or third-party photograph is included.

Generation tools are test-fixture tools only; they are not runtime dependencies. Their licences remain with their respective authors.
